name: Platinum Vape Disposable | Blue Zkittles
description:
Blue Zkittles is a candy-coated burst of blueberry and tropical fruit flavor that hits like your favorite bag of sweets. This 2-gram all-in-one packs pure Platinum distillate for a clean, potent high that’s equal parts relaxing, happy, and deliciously mellow.

Engineered with precision airflow and powerful dual-coil tech, every hit stays consistent — big clouds, no burn, all flavor. It’s everything you love about Platinum, now with double the dose.

Flavor Profile: Blueberry • Tropical Fruit • Sweet Candy

Effect: Relaxed • Happy • Uplifted

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Smooth Draw Design
